name: CFL Session Summary
query:
SELECT 
    cs.name as session_id,
    cs.date as session_date,
    cs.trainer_name,
    cs.participant_count,
    cs.village,
    cs.block,
    cs.cfl_center,
    cs.district,
    cs.region,
    cs.company,
    cs.employee,
    cs.feedback,
    CASE 
        WHEN cs.docstatus = 0 THEN 'Draft'
        WHEN cs.docstatus = 1 THEN 'Submitted' 
        WHEN cs.docstatus = 2 THEN 'Cancelled'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END as document_status,
    cs._state as workflow_state
FROM 
    `tabCFL Session` cs
WHERE 
    cs.date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    {conditions}
ORDER BY 
    cs.date DESC
